name: Velka Tamarind-Rose Hard Drops
manufacturer: Velka Sweets Co. (Corponation: Velka Consumer, mid-tier division)
description: Small faceted hard candy drops in a tamarind-rose flavor combination, sold in metal tins of thirty. The faceted shape is a Velka trademark — light catches the candy's amber-pink color in a way that photographs well and has driven significant social-feed presence.
flavor_profile: Sharp tamarind sour upfront that softens into floral rose mid-candy, mild sweetness at the finish, slight tannic dryness as it dissolves
cultural_context: The reusable tin has made Velka drops a carry-everywhere item — people refill them with other candies, use them for small storage, or collect tins with different seasonal lid-prints. The tin itself has secondary market value. In Tier 3 social circles, the tin you carry signals something about your aesthetic sensibility.
story_hooks: A courier always carries a Velka tin — but this one has a false bottom, and they don't know what was hidden there before it was passed to them.
Velka's seasonal tin artist has been embedding micro-scale visual data in the lid patterns; it's only visible to augmented eyes with the right filter.
A Tier 4 collector has been quietly buying limited seasonal tins in bulk, and the secondary market price spike is drawing attention to why.
